---
# ocp4_workload_guild_seats: one project per workshop seat, then the seat's RoleBindings

- name: Create a project for every seat
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    definition:
      apiVersion: v1
      kind: Namespace
      metadata:
        name: "{{ item }}-{{ guid }}"
  loop: "{{ guild_seats_users }}"

- name: Grant every seat its roles
  ansible.builtin.include_tasks: seat_access.yml
  loop: "{{ guild_seats_users }}"

# ocp4_workload_guild_seats: one project per workshop seat, then the seat's RoleBindings

- name: Create a project for every seat
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    definition:
      apiVersion: v1
      kind: Namespace

        name: "{{ item }}-{{ guid }}"
  loop: "{{ guild_seats_users }}"

- name: Grant every seat its roles
  ansible.builtin.include_tasks: seat_access.yml

---
# seat_access.yml: bind one seat's user to every role in guild_seats_roles

- name: Bind the seat user to its roles
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    definition:
      apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
      kind: RoleBinding
      metadata:
        name: "seat-{{ item }}"
        namespace: "{{ item }}-{{ guid }}"
      roleRef:
        apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
        kind: ClusterRole
        name: "{{ item }}"
      subjects:
        - apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
          kind: User
          name: "{{ item }}"
  loop: "{{ guild_seats_roles }}"

---
# ocp4_workload_guild_seats defaults
guild_seats_users:
  - guild-user1
  - guild-user2
  - guild-user3
guild_seats_roles:
  - edit
  - view
